observations: Two photos show the same industrial machine from different angles, indoors on tiled/terrazzo floor.
Machine has a tall vertical frame with a pneumatic cylinder/rod at top, a control box with two round pressure gauges and a digital timer/display, and a red emergency-stop style button.
Below the control box, two black pneumatic clamp heads sit over a blue-and-cream base cabinet.

A second cream/blue cabinet to the right has a top chamber with dark rubber/plastic forming fingers or clamps (consistent with a bottle-neck holding station) and a separate control panel with a grid of push-buttons.
A green toolbox sits on top of the right cabinet in both photos.
Dark bags/pouches lie on the floor near the machine's base.
No brand name, model number, serial plate, or capacity rating is visible or legible in either photo.
Watermark reads 'MARTHA OKPALA' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' - this is the seller/poster identity, not a manufacturer mark.
No power cable, compressor, mold set, or bottle sample is shown; machine is not shown running or producing a bottle.
